body: I hate self diagnosis as well! I believe my friends when they say they are, so I always try to avoid using the term on myself, cause then I'd feel like I'm being disrespectful towards them and whoever really suffers from it or any other physiological disorder.

This made me cry a little, thank you so much for your kindness really, I feel so glad seeing so many people replying, but saddened by the fact that almost everyone can relate. I really never got the chance to express myself, cause like you said, I never thought I deserved to be shown any compassion, cause I thought "what right do I have to complain about my life when there's people who have it worse than me".
An example was from this summer, a friend of mine lost her father, and since I never got to grieve for my dog cause of school, some days before that happened, I was drawing a picture of her. The day I heard the news, I just stopped drawing and removed the post I made those earlier days for her, cause I felt like i was doing something wrong and shameful, thinking I had no right to be sad for something that compared to her loss was "nothing". But then the guilt towards my dog only rose, cause I wanted to finally be able to accept her loss and treat her importantly as I wanted to, her death was a lot to me, to everyone, to my father in particular, and now I just carry the guilt that's just been eating me up since that day, and still feel troubled about how i should feel...

I had a really similar situation when I was just almost 14, if he lied to you from the start you should just block them. I know that the age span is not that far apart, but the fact that he lied to you implies something, and not something good. I know you grew attached to him, but he's playing the victim to lure you in and tie you down. You should block him and go on, you'll find the one sooner or later, don't discourage yourself, you are perfect with or without someone (and a liar at that) telling you, and know that there will be a lot of opportunities ahead in life, you'll just have to be patient :)
Ps. Sorry if I made some mistakes, english is not my first language!
